title: Get leaders to support and model the change
summary: People copy what leaders do. If leaders keep asking for feature lists and dates, the new way of working won't last.

beginner: Show leaders the results from the pilots.
Explain what you need them to do differently.
Agree two or three visible behaviours, such as asking about outcomes.
Give them simple prompts to use in meetings.
intermediate: Build a guiding group of leaders who champion the change.
Address leaders who block the change directly.
Celebrate teams that work the new way.
experienced: Change leadership routines, such as planning and reviews.
Link leaders' goals to the new way of working.
Coach senior leaders through their own change.

toolExamples.google-docs: Share a one-page guide for leaders.

pitfalls: Assuming leaders will change on their own
